notes: Front: Ektachrome by J. Boyd Ellis, published by Ellis Post Card Co., Arlington, WA. Caption: ‘Mount Shuksan in Mt. Baker National Forest located in northwest Washington… taken from near Mt. Baker Lodge.’ 8¢ Einstein stamp. Message: “June 9-71. Dear sis & Bro — all well here & sure pretty. Louise said you should be sure and fish.
